summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Hermann Bauer, a German naval officer (1875–1958) who commanded the U-boat forces of the Kaiserliche Marine in World War I. It also notes that he wrote the treatise "Das Unterseeboot" on U-boat design and operation, which Hyman G. Rickover later translated into English and which became a basic text for the US submarine service.
one_line: Hermann Bauer was a German naval officer who led Kaiserliche Marine U-boat forces in WWI and wrote the U-boat treatise "Das Unterseeboot".
key_facts: Hermann Bauer was born on 22 July 1875 and died on 11 February 1958.
Hermann Bauer was a German naval officer.
Hermann Bauer served as commander of the U-boat forces of the "Kaiserliche Marine" during World War I.
Hermann Bauer is known as the author of the book "Das Unterseeboot".
"Das Unterseeboot" is a treatise on the design and operation of U-boats.
"Das Unterseeboot" was later translated into English by Hyman G. Rickover.
Rickover's English translation of "Das Unterseeboot" became a basic text for the US submarine service.
